newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Scotts sees lower 2nd half results.
newsitem.headline: Scotts sees lower 2nd half results.

text.p: Property and leisure company Scotts Holdings Ltd said on Monday it expected its results in the second half of its financial year to be lower.
Scotts said in a statement issued with its interim results that its hospitality division had continued to perform well and had achieved improved earnings during the first half.
But it said increased competition and a generally slower retail market in Singapore led Scotts Shopping Centre to report a 20 percent drop in profit compared to the corresponding period last year.

"Due mainly to the closure of the Picnic Food Court for a period of four months for renovations, and that associated companies are not likely to continue the positive trend, the outlook for the group's performance is expected to be lower in the second half year," it said.
